top_signals.title: ADB chief warns of high inflation in Asia amid uncertainty
top_signals.summary: "The global economy is facing unprecedented uncertainty," said Masato Kanda, a former Japanese vice finance minister for international affairs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Busan International Film Festival builds momentum as an ‘A-list’ festival
top_signals.summary: The Busan International Film Festival, long a showcase of Asian talent, completed its first run as an "A-list" festival.
